title: Find the full name of the member with an X-Large t-shirt size who attended
question: Find the full name of the member with an X-Large t-shirt size who attended the event with the highest attendance.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_039 = 'X-Large'
  AND a.XCL_001 = (
    SELECT a2.XCL_001
    FROM attendance AS a2
    GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    ORDER BY COUNT(a2.XCL_002) DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )

FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
